mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate profit margins through higher wage pressures and lower consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending supply shock that disrupts corporate operations and reduces earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals higher discount rates that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
